title: 在复杂隐藏角色游戏中评估大型语言模型
summary: 本研究在社交推理游戏《秘密希特勒》中评估LLM的推理、说服和欺骗能力。提出了开源框架和新指标（角色识别准确率、欺骗保持率、游戏状态影响率）。发现LLM在对话能力与战略深度之间存在差距，推理增强技术未能提升胜率，当前架构在多轮操纵中表现低效。
summary_en: This work evaluates LLMs' reasoning, persuasion, and deception capabilities in the social deduction game Secret Hitler. It introduces an open-source framework and novel metrics, revealing a gap between conversational ability and strategic depth. Reasoning enhancements fail to improve win rates; current architectures remain ineffective at multi-turn manipulation.
